identity.description: An attacker executes a remote monitoring tool via PowerShell to establish persistence and remote access. Cortex should detect the execution of uncommon tools like 'PsExec' or 'WMI' from unexpected locations, triggering the 'Uncommon remote monitoring and management tool' alert.

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process starts with hidden window
Suspicious file downloaded to temp directory

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Remote Monitoring Tool Execution
biocs.description: Detection of execution of PsExec or similar tools from non-standard locations
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe' and actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Temp' or action_file_path contains 'Windows\\System32'

abiocs.name: Suspicious PowerShell Process Launching Remote Tool
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where PowerShell launches an uncommon remote monitoring tool from Temp directory
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Temp'

xql_queries.name: Detect PsExec Execution from Temp Directory
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe' and action_file_path contains 'Temp'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
